audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas — four rows away from the published mirror.
audit.why: The mirror audit (gragas__warwick) flipped both of its charts as one atomic group to Skill / Gragas / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Skill.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3, 4 and 6 flipped on both layers as one atomic group, with whys[2..4] and whys[6] rewritten to match and phases[1]/[5] ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Warwick's spike; the item stages had no cooldowns attached.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s and Explosive Cask is 100/85/70s. Both are answers to Infinite Duress, so 6 gives Gragas a second one rather than giving Warwick a window. Jaws of the Beast scales off maximum health, which is what makes the two-item stage recoverable.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, spikes[1], spikes[2], spikes[3], mid, late and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the real timers and the max-health scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said Infinite Duress 'is a point-blank lock that ignores his Body Slam', and mid said it 'suppresses him through everything'. Both are the opposite of the truth.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is flagged channel: interruptible. Body Slam is hard CC (a stun) and Explosive Cask is a knockback — either cancels the channel. Separately, the ult's leap distance scales with bonus Move Speed, and Blood Hunt only grants Move Speed toward enemies already under 50% health, so the long-range engage requires chipping him first.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in spikes[1], mid, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d, including the Blood Hunt / leap-distance dependency the mirror surfaced.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] and late describe Drunken Rage as a 'percent-HP W'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Drunken Rage is magic damage to nearby enemies on his next basic attack plus reduced damage received — no percent-health component anywhere. The derived flags list only autoReset.
audit.corrected: Both sentences rewritten without the invented percent-health claim.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Your Infinite Duress' and 'Save Explosive Cask' — the matcher caught the leading verb/pronoun. Both names are correct.

edits.before: At 3 your Blood Hunt speed and Q-reset heal out-trade his mana-hungry poke.
edits.after: Level 3 is skill — Barrel Roll is 8s at rank 3 and Body Slam 13s; fight the gap.

edits.before: Through 4-5 you dive low Gragas past his short Body Slam escape.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are Gragas's — his Body Slam stun cancels your ult.

edits.before: Level 6 Infinite Duress locks him down before Explosive Cask can peel.
edits.after: Level 6 is Gragas's — Explosive Cask knocks you out of the Duress channel.

edits.before: With full items Gragas's Cask knockback and tank stats outlast your single-target R.
edits.after: With 2+ items it evens out — Jaws of the Beast scales off the health he stacks.

edits.before: Your Infinite Duress is a point-blank lock that ignores his Body Slam (E) dash escape; if he E's in to poke, answer with Primal Howl fear then R to suppress and burst him before Explosive Cask (R) is up.
edits.after: Infinite Duress leaps further with bonus Move Speed, and Blood Hunt only grants that toward a target under 50% health — chip him first. Body Slam's stun cancels the channel, so fear it out with Primal Howl, then ult.

edits.before: You stay ahead: Gragas is squishy for a top laner and your all-in kill threat with R plus jungle collapse punishes his short E range, so keep freezing him off farm and diving on Blood Hunt marks.
edits.after: This is where he tips it: Happy Hour heals him every time he casts a skill, so poke you cannot follow up is free value for him. Freeze instead, and dive only while Body Slam sits on its 13-second cooldown.

edits.before: Late Gragas becomes a utility bruiser whose Explosive Cask (R) knockback disrupts your engage and peels you off carries; his percent-HP W and tanky items let him survive your R, so he edges the extended teamfight.
edits.after: Late Gragas is a utility bruiser: Explosive Cask knocks you off carries and Drunken Rage cuts the damage he takes. Jaws of the Beast still scales off the health he stacks, so bite him and let your team clean up.

edits.before: From 3 through 6 you dominate; Blood Hunt speeds you onto him past his Body Slam range, Primal Howl fears his dash escape, and at 6 Infinite Duress suppresses him through everything for a clean kill before his Cask comes up.
edits.after: From 3 through 6 Gragas holds the edge; Body Slam is 14s at rank 1 and its stun cancels Infinite Duress, so the ult is never a fight starter here — spend Primal Howl on his charge, then bite while that E is down.

edits.before: With items Gragas tips ahead: Explosive Cask (R) knocks you off your target and his percent-HP W plus tank build let him outlast your Infinite Duress, so trade lane priority for objectives and avoid solo all-ins late.
edits.after: With items it levels out: Explosive Cask is 100s at rank 1 and still knocks you off a target, but Jaws of the Beast scales off the health he stacks, so bite the tank and pick your ult target once his Cask is spent.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gragas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a channel, and both Body Slam's stun and Explosive Cask's knockback cancel it — at 6 he gains a second answer, so the level is not your window.

edits.before: - Gragas Body Slam: matchup-defining — His engage. R when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Body Slam: 14s at rank 1, his engage and the stun that cancels your ult. - Barrel Roll: 10s at rank 1, and it ramps for 4 seconds before it blows. - Infinite Duress: 110s — spend it only once his E is gone.

edits.before: His engage. R when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His engage and your ult's counter — commit only once Body Slam is spent.

edits.after: Q-bite Gragas as he steps up, holding Q to follow his Body Slam, and let Eternal Hunger heal you back under half health.
